title: Changes
lyrics_plain:
I feel unhappy!
I feel so sad!
I lost the best friend
that I ever had!
She was my woman!
I loved her so!
But it's too late now!
I've let her go!
I'm going through changes!
I'm going through changes!
We shared the eve's!
We shared each day!
In love together
we found a way!
But soon the world
had its evil way!
My heart was blinded!
Love went astray!
I'm going through changes!
I'm going through changes!
It took so long
to realize
that I can still hear
her last goodbyes!
Now all my days
are filled with tears!
Wish I could go back
and change these years!
I'm going through changes!
I'm going through changes!
